entries/blocks/antilife.json::/pages/1/t: $(bold)Conversion:$()$(br)AntiLife spreads to adjacent blocks of the same type as the original converted block.$(br2)$(bold)LP Cost:$()$(br)Each spread consumes LP from the player who created it (configurable).$(br2)$(bold)Range:$()$(br)Spreads up to 8 blocks from the origin (configurable with the sigil).
entries/blocks/antilife.json::/pages/2/t: $(bold)Breaking AntiLife:$()$(br)When any AntiLife block is broken, it triggers a decay chain reaction.$(br2)$(li)All adjacent AntiLife blocks start decaying$(li)Decay spreads to other AntiLife$(li)Decayed blocks are removed$(br2)This prevents infinite expansion and allows cleanup.$(br2)$(bold)Protected Blocks:$() Cannot convert blocks tagged $(#888888)animus:disallow_antilife$().
entries/blocks/antilife_fluid.json::/pag: A corrupting liquid that spreads destruction. AntiLife fluid is created when lightning strikes Life Essence from Blood Magic, transforming it into a dark, consuming force.

$(bold)How to Create:$()$(br)Place Life Essence fluid from Blood Magic and strike it with lightning (use a $(item)Lightning Rod$() or the $(l:animus:sigils/sigil_storm)Sigil of the Storm$()).$(br2)The Life Essence will instantly transform into AntiLife fluid, which:$(li)Spreads like water$(li)Consumes blocks it touches$(li)Cannot be reversed$(li)Can be collected in buckets

$(bold)Spreading:$()$(br)When AntiLife fluid touches blocks, it converts them to $(l:animus:blocks/antilife)AntiLife blocks$(), which continue to spread the corruption.$(br2)$(bold)Life Essence Interaction:$()$(br)When AntiLife fluid touches Life Essence fluid, it spreads as fluid instead of converting to blocks, rapidly corrupting large volumes.$(br2)$(bold)Warning:$() Handle with extreme care!

entries/bloodtrees/decorative_blocks.jso: Blood Wood harvested from Blood Trees can be processed into a variety of decorative building blocks. The crimson wood makes for striking architectural accents.
Use an axe on Blood Wood logs to strip the bark, revealing a smoother texture. Works just like stripping vanilla logs.
Craft Blood Wood logs into planks (4 planks per log). These planks serve as the base for all other decorative variants.
Craft 6 planks in a stair pattern to create Blood Wood Stairs. Perfect for grand staircases in your blood magic sanctum.
Craft 3 planks in a row to create Blood Wood Slabs. Use for flooring, shelves, or decorative trim.
Craft planks and sticks in the standard fence pattern. Use to corral your sacrifices or decorate your ritual grounds.
Craft sticks and planks in the gate pattern. Allows passage through Blood Wood fences while keeping mobs contained.

$(bold)Crafting Summary:$()$(li)Log → 4 Planks$(li)6 Planks → 4 Stairs$(li)3 Planks → 6 Slabs$(li)4 Planks + 2 Sticks → 3 Fences$(li)2 Planks + 4 Sticks → 1 Gate$(br2)All Blood Wood blocks work with standard wood recipes and can be used as fuel.$(br2)$(italic)Build your dark empire in crimson.$()
entries/compatibility/arcane_rune.json::: The Arcane Rune is a revolutionary altar component that bridges Ars Nouveau's Source magic with Blood Magic's altar system. Unlike traditional runes that provide static bonuses, the Arcane Rune's power fluctuates based on its internal Source supply.

Crafted using $(item)Blank Rune$() at the center, any $(item)Stone$() in corners, $(item)Blank Slate$() top and bottom, and $(item)Source Gems$() on the sides. This combines Blood Magic and Ars Nouveau components into a hybrid rune.

$(animus)Source-Powered Rune$()$(br2)Place this rune in your Blood Altar structure just like any other rune. It stores up to 1000 Source internally and can receive Source via Ars Nouveau's dominion wand linking system.

To supply the Arcane Rune with Source:$(br2)1. Hold a $(item)Dominion Wand$()$(br)2. Sneak + Right-click a $(item)Source Jar$() or $(item)Relay$() to select it$(br)3. Right-click the $(item)Arcane Rune$() to link them$(br)4. Source will automatically flow to the rune$(br2)The rune holds up to 1000 Source. You must link it - it cannot pull Source on its own!

The Arcane Rune has two distinct states based on Source availability:$(br2)$(blood)Powered State$() (20 Source consumed every 10 seconds):$(li)Acts as a Speed Rune but 20%% faster$(li)Provides Dislocation Rune bonus$(br2)$(will)Unpowered State$() (No Source available):$(li)Acts as a Speed Rune at 67.5%% effectiveness$(li)No Dislocation bonus

The Arcane Rune excels in hybrid builds:$(br2)$(li)Provides superior altar speed when Source is plentiful$(li)Acts as a backup speed rune when Source runs out$(li)The dislocation bonus increases LP transfer rate$(br2)Consider the Source consumption rate (20 per 10 seconds = 2 Source/second per rune) when planning your Source generation and storage capacity. This can be configured in the config file.

To use the Arcane Rune:$(li)$(animus)Ars Nouveau must be installed$()$(li)Use a Dominion Wand to link Source Jars$(li)Ensure linked jars are kept filled$(br2)The rune emits a subtle glow (light level 7) when placed, making it easy to identify in your altar structure.
entries/compatibility/blood_infused_spel: The Blood-Infused Spellbook combines the power of Iron's Spells with Blood Magic's sacrificial arts. This unique tome can be progressively enhanced through $(blood)six tiers of blood infusion$(), each granting powerful new abilities.$(br2)Unlike regular spellbooks, this hybrid tome grows stronger as you feed it more Life Essence at the Blood Altar.

$(blood)Blood-Powered Spellbook$()$(br2)A spellbook infused with the power of blood magic. Place any Iron's Spells spellbook in the Blood Altar to create one, then right-click to upgrade it.$(br2)$(bold)Base Stats:$() 5 spell slots$(br)$(bold)Max Tier:$() 6 (12 slots, +300 mana)

To create a Blood-Infused Spellbook:$(br2)1. Obtain any $(item)Spellbook$() from Iron's Spells$(br)2. $(bold)Place the spellbook in the Blood Altar$()$(br)3. Ensure the altar has $(blood)5,000 LP$() stored$(br)4. Wait for the altar to craft it$(br2)The spellbook transforms into a $(blood)Tier 1 Blood-Infused Spellbook$(). $(thing)All your equipped spells are preserved!$()

Each tier grants $(thing)+50 Max Mana$() and more spell slots:$(br2)$(bold)Tiers 1-3: Slot & Mana Bonuses$()$(li)$(blood)Tier 1:$() Weak Orb, 5k LP $(thing)6 slots, +50 mana$()$(li)$(blood)Tier 2:$() Apprentice Orb, 10k LP $(thing)7 slots, +100 mana$()$(li)$(blood)Tier 3:$() Magician Orb, 25k LP $(thing)8 slots, +150 mana$()

$(bold)Tiers 4-6: LP Cost & Lifesteal$()$(li)$(blood)Tier 4:$() Master Orb, 50k LP $(thing)10 slots, +200 mana, -10%% LP$()$(li)$(blood)Tier 5:$() Archmage Orb, 100k LP $(thing)11 slots, +250 mana, -20%% LP$()$(li)$(blood)Tier 6:$() Transcendent Orb, 175k LP $(thing)12 slots, +300 mana, +5%% lifesteal$()

To upgrade your spellbook to the next tier:$(br2)1. Place the required Blood Orb tier (or higher) in the altar$(br)2. Ensure the altar has enough LP$(br)3. Right-click the altar while holding your Blood-Infused Spellbook$(br2)The spellbook's tooltip shows your current tier, bonuses, and the requirements for the next upgrade. JEI also displays all upgrade recipes.

When you don't have enough mana, the Blood-Infused Spellbook can $(blood)consume LP instead$()!$(br2)$(bold)Requirements:$()$(li)A $(item)Blood Orb$() in your inventory or curio slot$(li)Sufficient LP in your Soul Network$(br2)The LP cost is $(thing)100 LP per mana$() by default. Higher tier spellbooks reduce this cost by up to 20%%. This can be configured or disabled in the mod settings.

To use the Blood-Infused Spellbook:$(br2)$(li)$(mod)Iron's Spellbooks$() must be installed$(li)An active $(l:bloodmagicnv:altar/binding)Soul Network$()$(li)A Blood Altar with the appropriate orb tier$(br2)The spellbook's rarity and enchantment glint change based on its infusion tier, making it easy to see how powerful your tome has become.
entries/compatibility/hand_of_death.json: The Hand of Death is the ultimate evolution of the Runic Sentient Scythe. Forged with demon steel and infused with deathly power, this weapon executes weakened foes and heals its wielder through the lifeforce of the slain.
$(will)Ultimate Soul Reaper$()$(br2)The pinnacle of demonic weaponry. Combines all features of the Runic Sentient Scythe with devastating lifesteal and execute mechanics.

Every strike with the Hand of Death heals you for $(blood)20%%$() of the damage dealt:$(br2)$(li)Minimum heal of 1 health$(li)Works on all damage$(li)Stacks with other healing$(li)No cooldown$(br2)$(italic)Combined with the weapon's high damage, this provides substantial sustain in prolonged fights.$()

When an enemy falls below $(blood)15%%$() health, the Hand of Death can $(bold)instantly execute$() them:$(br2)$(li)Triggers on your next hit$(li)Bypasses remaining health$(li)Shows execution message$(li)Full soul/spirit drops$(br2)$(will)⚰ EXECUTED$()$(br2)This makes the weapon devastating against high-health targets and bosses.

The Hand of Death retains all features from the $(l:animus:compatibility/runic_sentient_scythe)Runic Sentient Scythe$():$(br2)$(li)$(will)+30%% attack speed$()$(li)Full demon will scaling$(li)Malum spirit harvesting$(li)All sentient weapon effects$(br2)$(bold)+14 bonus base damage$() over the Runic Sentient Scythe makes this one of the most powerful melee weapons available.

The Hand of Death requires advanced materials:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Runic Sentient Scythe$()$(li)$(item)Demon Forged Steel$()$(li)$(blood)Significant Life Essence$()$(br2)This is an end-game weapon requiring mastery of both Blood Magic and Malum systems. See the recipe for exact crafting requirements.

entries/compatibility/living_armor_ars_n: Living Armor adapts to your magical practices. When practicing Ars Nouveau's glyph-based magic, your armor learns and evolves, unlocking the $(bold)Source Attunement$() upgrade path designed specifically for source-wielding mages.
$(blood)Source-Infused Armor$()$(br2)Cast Ars Nouveau spells while wearing Living Armor to gain experience. Your armor attunes to the flow of Source energy, growing stronger with each glyph you cast.

Every Ars Nouveau spell you cast grants XP to your Living Armor based on its complexity:$(br2)$(bold)Formula:$()$(br)Base XP (5) × Number of Glyphs$(br2)$(italic)Example: A spell with 6 glyphs grants 5 × 6 = 30 XP$()$(br2)More complex spells with many glyphs will level your armor faster. Experiment with elaborate spell combinations to maximize your progression!

The Source Attunement upgrade tree provides five levels of powerful spell enhancements:$(br2)$(blood)Level 1:$() +5%% Spell Damage$(br2)$(blood)Level 2:$() +10%% Spell Damage$(br2)$(blood)Level 3:$() +15%% Spell Damage$(br2)$(blood)Level 4:$() +20%% Spell Damage$(br)Mana Regen buff (4s)$(br2)$(blood)Level 5:$() +25%% Spell Damage$(br)Mana Cost -20%%$(br)Spell Damage III buff (5s)

Each level requires Living Armor points:$(br2)$(li)$(blood)Level 1:$() 5 points$(li)$(blood)Level 2:$() 10 points$(li)$(blood)Level 3:$() 15 points$(li)$(blood)Level 4:$() 20 points$(li)$(blood)Level 5:$() 25 points$(br2)$(bold)Total:$() 75 points for all levels$(br2)These points are earned through Living Armor's normal progression system - wear the armor, gain XP from spell casting and other sources.

$(bold)Levels 1-3: Increasing Spell Damage$()$(br)Each level adds +5%% spell damage. By level 3, you're dealing 15%% more damage with all Ars Nouveau spells.$(br2)$(bold)Level 4: Damage & Regen$()$(br)Spell damage increases to +20%%. Additionally, every spell cast grants you the $(effect)Mana Regeneration$() effect for 4 seconds, helping you recover mana faster.$(br2)$(bold)Level 5: Ultimate Power$()$(br)Peak performance at +25%% spell damage. Casting spells grants $(effect)Spell Damage III$() for 5 seconds AND refunds 20%% of the mana cost!

$(bold)Synergies:$()$(li)Stack Spell Damage III with Ars Nouveau's native damage buffs$(li)Level 4 Mana Regen helps with sustained casting$(li)Level 5's 20%% mana refund makes expensive spells more viable$(li)Combine with mana-generating equipment for infinite casting$(li)Pair with speed enchantments to cast more frequently$(li)Use with other Living Armor upgrades for balanced combat$(br2)At max level, you're a spell-slinging powerhouse with massive damage and efficient mana usage!

$(bold)Maximize XP Gain:$()$(li)Create longer, more complex spells$(li)Each glyph counts toward XP$(li)Practice new spell combinations$(li)Cast frequently while exploring$(br2)$(bold)Build Paths:$()$(li)Pure Source Mage: Max Source Attunement first$(li)Battlemage: Balance with melee upgrades$(li)Tank Mage: Combine with defensive upgrades$(br2)$(italic)Remember: XP is only granted while wearing Living Armor!$()
entries/compatibility/living_armor_spell: Living Armor evolves with you, and now it can grow stronger through spellcasting. Every spell you cast grants experience to your Living Armor, and the new $(bold)Arcane Channeling$() upgrade path provides powerful benefits for spellcasters.

$(blood)Spellcaster's Armor$()$(br2)Wear Living Armor while casting spells to gain experience. The armor learns from your magical prowess and unlocks the Arcane Channeling upgrade tree, specifically designed for mages.

Every spell you cast grants XP to your Living Armor:$(br2)$(bold)Formula:$()$(br)Base XP (10) x Spell Level x Rarity Multiplier$(br2)$(bold)Rarity Multipliers:$()$(li)Common: x1.0$(li)Uncommon: x1.5$(li)Rare: x2.0$(li)Epic: x3.0$(li)Legendary: x5.0

$(italic)Example: A level 3 Rare spell grants 10 x 3 x 2.0 = 60 XP$()$(br2)The Arcane Channeling upgrade tree provides five levels:$(br2)Level 1: -5%% Mana Cost$(br)Level 2: -10%% Mana Cost$(br)Level 3: -5%% Cooldown$(br)Level 4: -10%% Cooldown$(br)Level 5: Resistance on Cast

Each level requires Living Armor points:$(br2)$(li)$(blood)Level 1:$() 5 points$(li)$(blood)Level 2:$() 10 points$(li)$(blood)Level 3:$() 15 points$(li)$(blood)Level 4:$() 20 points$(li)$(blood)Level 5:$() 25 points$(br2)$(bold)Total:$() 75 points for all levels$(br2)Points are earned through Living Armor's normal progression - wear the armor and gain XP from spellcasting.

Arcane Channeling works well with:$(br2)$(li)$(l:animus:compatibility/blood_infused_spellbook)Blood-Infused Spellbook$()$(br)Stack mana cost reductions$(br2)$(li)$(l:animus:compatibility/sigil_crimson_will)Sigil of Crimson Will$()$(br)Damage boost + mana efficiency$(br2)$(li)$(l:animus:compatibility/sanguine_scrolls)Sanguine Scrolls$()$(br)Cast from scrolls while gaining XP$(br2)$(italic)The armor gains XP from any spell, including those cast with LP!$()

entries/compatibility/ritual_arcane_mast: The Ritual of Arcane Mastery bridges Blood Magic's ritual system with Iron's Spells learning mechanics. This powerful ritual can teach you new spells or upgrade existing ones by consuming scrolls placed in nearby chests.

$(blood)Spell Learning Ritual$()$(br2)Place spell scrolls in chests within 5 blocks of the Master Ritual Stone. The ritual will automatically process scrolls, teaching you new spells or upgrading ones you already know.

The ritual searches for $(item)Iron's Spells Scrolls$() in chests within a 5-block radius (horizontal and vertical).$(br2)$(bold)If you don't know the spell:$()$(br)• Consumes the scroll$(br)• Teaches you the spell at level 1$(br)• Costs LP based on spell rarity$(br2)$(bold)If you already know the spell:$()$(br)• Consumes the scroll$(br)• Upgrades spell level by +1$(br)• LP cost = Base cost × Current level

LP costs scale with spell rarity:$(br2)• $(item)Common:$() 5,000 LP$(br)• $(item)Uncommon:$() 10,000 LP$(br)• $(item)Rare:$() 25,000 LP$(br)• $(item)Epic:$() 50,000 LP$(br)• $(item)Legendary:$() 100,000 LP$(br2)$(bold)Upgrade Cost Formula:$()$(br)Base cost × Current spell level$(br2)$(italic)Example: Upgrading a Rare spell from level 2 to 3 costs 25,000 × 2 = 50,000 LP$()

1. Build the ritual pattern (see next page)$(br)2. Activate with $(blood)10,000 LP$()$(br)3. Place chest(s) within 5 blocks$(br)4. Put spell scrolls in chest$(br)5. Wait for ritual to process$(br2)$(bold)Processing:$()$(br)• Checks every 2 seconds$(br)• Processes one scroll at a time$(br)• Emits smoke if no scrolls found$(br)• Enchantment particles on success

The Ritual of Arcane Mastery uses a knowledge-themed pattern:$(br2)$(bold)Inner Circle$() (2 blocks):$(br)• 4 Dusk Runes (cardinal directions)$(br2)$(bold)Middle Ring$() (2 blocks diagonal):$(br)• 4 Air Runes (diagonals)$(br2)$(bold)Outer Ring$() (3 blocks):$(br)• 4 Dusk Runes (cardinal)$(br)• 4 Air Runes (corners)$(br2)Total: 8 Dusk, 8 Air runes

$(bold)Efficient Learning:$()$(br)• Group common spells together$(br)• Keep high-value scrolls separate$(br)• Monitor LP levels$(br)• Use activation crystals to start/stop$(br2)$(bold)Bulk Processing:$()$(br)• Fill multiple chests with scrolls$(br)• Ritual processes continuously$(br)• Check back periodically$(br2)$(italic)The ritual respects spell max levels - you cannot upgrade beyond a spell's natural maximum.$()

To use this ritual:$(br)• $(blood)Iron's Spellbooks must be installed$()$(br)• Active $(l:bloodmagic:altar/binding)Soul Network$()$(br)• Sufficient LP for activation and learning$(br)• Iron's Spells scrolls$(br)• Chest(s) for scroll storage$(br2)$(bold)Activation:$()$(br)• 10,000 LP initial cost$(br)• $(item)Weak Activation Crystal$() to activate$(br)• No ongoing refresh cost

entries/compatibility/rune_unleashed_nat: The Rune of Unleashed Nature is a hybrid altar component that channels Botania's mana into Blood Magic's altar system. Crafted using a $(item)Blank Rune$() surrounded by Botania's $(item)Livingwood$() and $(item)Manasteel$(). This creates a living altar rune that responds to mana flow.

$(animus)Mana-Powered Rune$()$(br2)This rune functions as a small $(item)Mana Pool$() that can be placed in your Blood Altar structure. It stores up to 10,000 mana internally and provides bonuses based on its charge level.

The Rune of Unleashed Nature provides bonuses even when empty:$(br2)$(blood)Always Active:$()$(li)Capacity Bonus: Provides 135%% of a Capacity Rune's effect$(li)Orb Bonus: Provides 67.5%% of a Rune of the Orb's effect, increasing Soul Network storage$(br2)These passive bonuses make it valuable even without mana.

When the rune has mana in its internal buffer:$(br2)$(will)Mana-Powered:$()$(li)Acceleration Bonus: Speeds up altar crafting and LP generation$(li)Consumes 10 mana per second while active$(br2)The acceleration effect stacks with other speed-enhancing runes, making high-tier crafting faster.

Since the rune acts as a small Mana Pool, you can charge it using standard Botania methods:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Mana Spreader$(): Point a spreader at the rune to send mana bursts directly to it$(li)$(item)Spark$(): Place a Mana Spark on top of the rune to connect it to your spark network$(br2)The spark method is recommended for altar setups as it allows automatic mana distribution from your main pool.

entries/compatibility/runic_sentient_scy: The Runic Sentient Scythe combines the demonic power of Blood Magic's Sentient Scythe with runic enhancements and Malum soul harvesting. This deadly weapon attacks 30%% faster than its predecessor while reaping souls for the spirit altar.
$(will)Demon Will Weapon$()$(br2)Like the Sentient Scythe, this weapon scales with demon will in the chunk. It inherits all demon will effects while adding Malum's spirit harvesting capabilities.

The runic modifications grant a $(bold)30%% faster attack speed$() compared to the base Sentient Scythe. This allows for more rapid strikes and better demon will generation through combat.$(br2)$(italic)The faster attack speed synergizes well with Malum's soul harvesting, allowing you to reap more spirits per encounter.$()

When $(blood)Malum$() is installed, killing mobs with this scythe will harvest their spirits directly:$(br2)$(li)Spirits drop as if using a Malum scythe$(li)Works with all spirit types$(li)No additional soul data required$(li)Compatible with spirit pouches$(br2)This makes it an excellent tool for both Blood Magic demon will farming and Malum spirit collection.

The Runic Sentient Scythe is crafted at the $(blood)Alchemy Array$() using:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Sentient Scythe$()$(li)$(item)Malum Spirit Components$()$(li)$(blood)Life Essence$()$(br2)See the recipe for exact requirements. The crafting process infuses Malum's spirit magic into the Blood Magic weapon.
entries/compatibility/sanguine_scrolls.j: Sanguine Scrolls are reusable spell scrolls that consume Life Essence instead of being destroyed. Unlike regular scrolls, these blood-infused parchments can cast spells dozens or hundreds of times, limited only by their durability.

$(blood)Reusable Spell Scroll$()$(br2)Sanguine Scrolls store a single spell and can be used repeatedly. Each cast consumes LP from your Soul Network and damages the scroll slightly. The scroll's durability determines how many times it can be used.

To create a Sanguine Scroll:$(br2)1. Obtain an $(item)Iron's Spells Scroll$() containing the spell you want$(br)2. Place a $(blood)Blood Magic Slate$() in your offhand$(br)3. Right-click a $(blood)Blood Altar$() with the scroll$(br)4. The altar will consume LP and both items$(br)5. Receive a Sanguine Scroll with the spell bound$(br2)$(italic)The slate tier determines scroll durability.$()

Different slate types produce scrolls with varying durability:$(br2)$(li)$(blood)Blank Slate:$() 50 uses$(li)$(blood)Reinforced Slate:$() 100 uses$(li)$(blood)Imbued Slate:$() 200 uses$(li)$(blood)Demon Slate:$() 400 uses$(li)$(blood)Ethereal Slate:$() 600 uses$(br2)Higher-tier scrolls can cast more spells before breaking. Choose based on how frequently you'll use the spell.

Sanguine Scrolls consume more LP than normal spell casting:$(br2)$(bold)Base Cost:$() Mana cost × LP rate × 1.5$(br)$(italic)(Default: 150 LP per mana point)$()$(br2)$(bold)Creation Cost:$() Based on spell rarity and level$(li)Common: 5,000 LP × level$(li)Uncommon: 10,000 LP × level$(li)Rare: 25,000 LP × level$(li)Epic: 50,000 LP × level$(li)Legendary: 100,000 LP × level

Sanguine Scrolls excel for:$(br2)$(li)$(blood)Emergency spells$() - Quick access without spellbooks$(li)$(blood)Powerful spells$() - Cast legendary spells anytime$(li)$(blood)LP-heavy builds$() - Convert excess LP to magic$(li)$(blood)Backup casting$() - When out of mana$(br2)The 50%% LP premium is worth it for convenience and reliability. Store multiple scrolls for different situations.

$(bold)Durability Management:$()$(li)Check uses remaining in tooltip$(li)Higher-tier slates for frequently-used spells$(li)Keep spares of important spells$(br2)$(bold)Synergies:$()$(li)Combine with $(l:animus:compatibility/sigil_crimson_will)Sigil of Crimson Will$() for massive damage$(li)Use $(l:animus:compatibility/blood_infused_spellbook)Blood-Infused Spellbook$() to reduce LP costs$(br2)$(italic)Sanguine Scrolls work from any inventory slot.$()

To use Sanguine Scrolls:$(li)$(blood)Iron's Spellbooks must be installed$()$(li)Active $(l:bloodmagic:altar/binding)Soul Network$()$(li)Blood Altar for creation$(li)Slates from Blood Magic$(li)Iron's Spells scrolls to convert$(br2)Sanguine Scrolls respect spell cooldowns and cannot bypass casting restrictions.
entries/compatibility/sigil_crimson_will: The Sigil of Crimson Will empowers your spellcasting with both Life Essence and Demon Will. This toggleable sigil dramatically increases spell power and summon damage, scaling with the raw demon will stored in your Soul Network.

$(will)Demon Will Enhancement$()$(br2)Right-click to activate this sigil. While active, every spell you cast will consume LP and temporarily boost your spell power and summon damage through demonic empowerment.

The Sigil of Crimson Will provides:$(br2)$(bold)Base Bonus:$() $(blood)+30%%$() spell power and summon damage$(br2)$(bold)Demon Will Scaling:$()$(br)$(li)Scales up to $(will)+50%% total$() at 4096 demon will$(li)Uses demon will from your Soul Network$(li)Works with $(will)0 will$() (base 30%% only)$(br2)The bonus is applied only during spell casting and removed immediately after.

Each spell cast with the sigil active consumes:$(br2)$(blood)Life Essence:$()$(br)$(li)Configurable per mana point (default: 50 LP)$(li)Scales with spell level$(li)Example: 10-level spell = 500 LP$(br2)$(will)Demon Will:$()$(br)$(li)5 will per cast (if available)$(li)Consumes from Soul Network$(li)Optional - sigil works without will

The sigil has two states:$(br2)$(bold)Active:$() (glowing red icon)$(br)$(li)Consumes resources per spell$(li)Boosts spell power & summon damage$(li)Shows dynamic power bonus in tooltip$(br2)$(bold)Inactive:$() (gray icon)$(br)$(li)No resource consumption$(li)No power boost$(li)Right-click to toggle$(br2)The sigil must be $(l:bloodmagic:altar/binding)bound$() to your Soul Network to activate.

The Sigil of Crimson Will excels in:$(br2)$(li)$(blood)Boss fights$() - massive damage boost$(li)$(blood)Summoner builds$() - enhanced summons$(li)$(will)High-will scenarios$() - 50%% bonus$(br2)$(italic)Tip:$() Keep the sigil in your inventory (main hand, offhand, or any inventory slot). Deactivate between fights to conserve LP.$(br2)Combines excellently with the $(l:animus:compatibility/blood_infused_spellbook)Blood-Infused Spellbook$().

To use the Sigil of Crimson Will:$(br)$(li)$(blood)Iron's Spellbooks must be installed$()$(li)Active $(l:bloodmagic:altar/binding)Soul Network$()$(li)Sufficient LP for spell costs$(li)Optional: Demon will in Soul Network for scaling$(br2)The sigil applies attribute modifiers during casting, ensuring compatibility with other spell power modifiers.

entries/sigils/sigil_remedium.json::/pag: A toggleable sigil that continuously cleanses your body of harmful afflictions. While active, negative status effects are purged at a steady LP cost.

$(bold)Toggle:$() Right-click to activate/deactivate$(br)$(bold)LP Cost:$() 50 LP per effect removed$(br)$(bold)Interval:$() Once per second$(br2)While active, all negative (harmful) effects are automatically removed. The sigil will deactivate if you run out of LP.

$(bold)Beneficial Effects:$() Only harmful effects are removed; beneficial effects like Regeneration or Strength remain.$(br2)$(bold)Efficiency:$() The cost scales with the number of effects - cleansing 3 effects costs 150 LP.$(br2)$(italic)Purity through sacrifice.$()
entries/sigils/sigil_reparare.json::/pag: A toggleable sigil that mends your equipment over time. While active, damaged items in your inventory slowly repair themselves at the cost of LP.

$(bold)Toggle:$() Right-click to activate/deactivate$(br)$(bold)LP Cost:$() Configurable per durability point$(br)$(bold)Scope:$() All inventory slots, armor, and offhand$(br2)The sigil periodically scans for damaged items and repairs them. It will deactivate if you run out of LP.

$(bold)Blacklist:$() Items tagged with $(thing)animus:disallow_repair$() cannot be repaired by this sigil.$(br2)$(bold)Repair Rate:$() Configurable repair amount per interval.$(br2)$(italic)Blood mends what time breaks.$()
entries/sigils/sigil_storm.json::/pages/: Created using an $(blood)Alchemy Array$() by combining a $(l:animus:items/reagentstorm)Reagent: Storm$() with a $(item)Reinforced Slate$(). The reagent must first be forged in the Hellfire Forge.
Harness the fury of the heavens. The Sigil of the Storm calls down lightning upon your enemies and can even summon fish from the depths when targeting water.

$(bold)LP Cost:$() 500 per use$(br2)Right-click to call down lightning at the targeted location (up to 64 blocks away).$(br2)$(bold)Special:$() When targeting water, the lightning will yield fishing loot ($(#)2-5 rolls$() by default).$(br2)$(bold)Rain Boost:$() During rain, deals area damage to entities within 5 blocks of the strike point.

The fish loot spawning can be configured:$(li)Minimum rolls: 2 (default)$(li)Maximum rolls: 5 (default)$(li)Set both to 0 to disable$(br2)Loot spawns 1 second after lightning to prevent burning.$(br2)This sigil is perfect for fishing, combat, or simply showing off your mastery of the elements.
A sigil that accelerates time for block entities. Furnaces smelt faster, crops grow quicker, and machines process at incredible speeds.

$(bold)Activation:$() Sneak + Right-click on a block entity$(br)$(bold)Duration:$() 30 seconds per activation$(br2)Each activation increases the speed level. Repeatedly clicking the same block stacks the acceleration up to 32x speed.

$(bold)Level 1:$() 2x speed - 1,000 LP$(br)$(bold)Level 2:$() 4x speed - 2,000 LP$(br)$(bold)Level 3:$() 8x speed - 4,000 LP$(br)$(bold)Level 4:$() 16x speed - 8,000 LP$(br)$(bold)Level 5:$() 32x speed - 16,000 LP$(br2)$(bold)Refresh:$() 15,000 LP to reset timer at max level

$(bold)Blacklist:$() Blocks tagged with $(thing)animus:disallow_acceleration$() cannot be accelerated.$(br2)$(bold)Mod Compat:$() Will not stack with GAG's Temporal Pouch, Time in a Bottle, or JustDireThings' Time Wand.$(br2)$(italic)Time bends to the will of blood.$()
entries/sigils/sigil_transposition.json:: Created using an $(blood)Alchemy Array$() by combining a $(l:animus:items/reagenttransposition)Reagent: Transposition$() with a $(item)Demon Slate$(). The reagent must first be forged in the Hellfire Forge.
Move blocks and teleport entities through space itself. The Sigil of Transposition allows you to relocate blocks without breaking them, and transport entities to bound Teleposers.

$(bold)LP Cost:$() 5000 per transposition$(br2)$(bold)Step 1:$() Right-click a block to select it as the source. The sigil will activate.$(br2)$(bold)Step 2:$() Right-click on another block's face to move the selected block adjacent to it.$(br2)$(bold)Clear:$() Right-click air to clear selection.

$(bold)LP Cost:$() 2000 per teleportation$(br2)$(bold)Bind:$() Sneak + right-click a $(l:bloodmagic:utility/teleposer)Teleposer$() to bind its location.$(br2)$(bold)Teleport:$() Attack an entity to teleport it 1 block above the bound Teleposer.$(br2)$(bold)Player Restriction:$() Can only teleport players if they are sneaking.$(br2)$(italic)The Teleposer must still exist at the bound location for teleportation to work.$()

$(bold)Protection:$() Respects chunk protection (FTB Chunks, etc.)$(br2)$(bold)Relocation Tag:$() Cannot move blocks tagged $(#888888)forge:relocation_not_supported$()$(br2)$(bold)Destination:$() Target location must be air$(br2)$(bold)Teleposer:$() Must be bound to a valid Teleposer for entity teleportation$(br2)The sigil will chunk-load the source area during transposition to ensure safety.

Perfect for:$(li)Moving complex machinery$(li)Relocating filled chests$(li)Rearranging your base$(li)Moving spawners$(li)Transporting tile entities$(li)Teleporting mobs to farms$(li)Creating trap systems$(br2)$(italic)Beware: With great power comes great responsibility. Always verify you have permission before moving blocks or teleporting entities.$()
